description: GPS trail logger (GPX) for CardputerZero with Cap LoRa-1262

store.summary: Record GPS trails as GPX: speed, distance, map, elevation (Cap LoRa-1262)
store.description: Trail Recorder logs where you go using the GPS in the Cap LoRa-1262 and saves each trip as a standard GPX file (opens in Google Earth, Strava, Komoot, CalTopo...). Live dashboard with speed, pace, distance and time; a map of your path with waypoints and distance back to start; an elevation profile with climb and descent; and a satellite / accuracy view. Recording is crash-safe and survives the battery dying. Miles or kilometres (U). Enter starts/pauses, S saves, W marks a waypoint. Requires the Cap LoRa-1262.
